collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - TREE OF LIFE SUPPLIES (SUP-01..14, draft for the owner, 2026-11-17)
Cutting tools, bars of soap and bolts of cloth in The Tree of Life: blades made, lost and found, soap that slips away or smells of flowers, and sacks for the yellow fruit. Funny, practical and warm.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A pile of fish bones after a big catch: sharpen the best into cutting tools, or let the children make wind chimes.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After the biggest catch of the season, there is a mountain of fish bones behind the cooking pit. (subject) is about to throw them out when (subject.he/she) notices a few long, straight ones, just the right shape for a cutting tool. (friend) is already eyeing the rest for something else entirely.

choices.label: Let the Children Make Wind Chimes

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) picks out the best bones and spends the evening rubbing them to an edge on a flat stone, while (friend) holds the lamp and asks a question roughly every three breaths. By the end, (friend) can tell a good edge from a bad one, and the village has two new cutting tools.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) and the other children string the bones on cords and hang them in the trees. For the rest of the season, every breeze makes the whole village tinkle. Some people find it lovely. Some people find it very, very loud. Everyone agrees it smells a bit fishy for the first few days.
